text: Lesson 7 planned all three staging models. This lesson writes the real SQL, following that plan exactly, for stg_jaffle_shop__customers, orders, and payments.

stg_jaffle_shop__orders follows the same shape as every staging model in this platform: one source CTE, then a flat select that only renames and casts columns — id becomes order_id, user_id becomes customer_id, no joins anywhere.
stg_jaffle_shop__payments follows the identical shape, renaming id to payment_id. Every staging model in this project looks structurally the same, which is deliberate, not an accident.

dbt build dash dash select staging builds all three at once, without touching anything in the marts folder. Confirming success means querying each resulting table directly in Snowflake, not just trusting a green terminal.

With all three staging models built and confirmed, the next lesson moves to where the real logic lives: the intermediate and mart models, built with joins and aggregation on top of this staging layer.
